resources.string: Warnings when a sign-in code arrives during a call with a stranger, or many codes arrive at once.
A sign-in code arrived during, or just after, a call with someone who isn\'t in your contacts. Banks, delivery companies and the police never ask for codes. If the caller asks for it, it\'s a scam.
The code came as a missed call from %1$s.
Don\'t share the code with the caller
A sign-in code arrived during a call with a stranger.

plurals.name: otp_burst_text
plurals.item: %1$d code arrived from different services within minutes. If you didn\'t ask for it, someone may be trying to get into your accounts. Don\'t share it.
%1$d codes arrived from different services within minutes. If you didn\'t ask for them, someone may be trying to get into your accounts. Don\'t share any of them.
